name: Hugging Face Hub API
tagline: REST API for the ML model, dataset, and Space registry on Hugging Face.
description: The Hugging Face Hub API provides programmatic access to models, datasets, Spaces, and related repository metadata on huggingface.co. It is the primary machine-readable interface for listing, searching, downloading, and managing open AI artifacts and git-backed repos used across the ML ecosystem.

auth.details: Optional for public reads; Bearer token (HF access token) via Authorization header for private repos and write operations. Tokens created at https://huggingface.co/settings/tokens.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free users/orgs: best-effort public storage and 100 GB private storage; per 5-minute fixed window: 1,000 Hub API, 5,000 resolver, and 200 page requests. Anonymous/free quotas may vary with platform health.

rate_limits: 5-minute fixed windows. Hub API: 500 anonymous/IP; 1,000 Free; 2,500 PRO; 3,000 Team/Academia; 6,000 Enterprise; 10,000 Enterprise Plus; 100,000 Enterprise Plus with org IP ranges. Separate resolver/page quotas and unpublished action limits apply.
use_cases: search Hugging Face models by task or library
get model card and metadata for a repo id
list files in a model or dataset repository
download or resolve artifact URLs for a revision
list or filter public datasets by modality
